label: B25-PHYSICAL-RERUN
title: Run fresh 25 MHz synthesis, fitter and signoff STA
scope: 从 Gate D 全绿的 B25 候选建立全新远端 source/MIF manifest，在 GamePC 上串行执行 IP generation、synthesis、fitter、signoff STA 及非破坏性时钟/BRAM/CDC/MIF 报告；严格验证真实 sys_clk_25=40 ns 和 Quartus 对当前 MIF/RTL 的消费。
launch_preconditions: Candidate source SHA is clean and Gate D evidence is complete.
Fresh remote probe does not exist or is an empty task-local directory; no pre-existing Quartus database/output is reused.
GamePC lock is acquired and pre/post EDA process counts are recorded.
Generated boot.mif is rebuilt from the candidate and byte-checked against boot.bin before transfer.

physical_input_contract.tracked_sources: 47 root rtl files + 2 platform RTL + QPF/QSF/SDC + generated boot MIF; preserve QSF relative aliases required by the existing project.
physical_input_contract.generated_mif: WIDTH=64 DEPTH=8192, byte0 in bits [7:0], all 8192 words checked against boot.bin.
physical_input_contract.stale_database_guard: Reject any pre-existing db/incremental_db/output_files before synthesis; retain failed fresh probe for evidence.
physical_input_contract.reference_policy: Use a10-linux-riscv only for documented platform pitfalls and reproducibility; do not copy RV32/OpenSBI/Linux CPU or address-map assets.

validation: Local check_platform.py, check_skeleton.py --require-boot-image, SHA256SUMS and candidate manifest closure.
Remote preflight and source/MIF hash closure under gamepc lock.
quartus_sh --flow compile catapult_a10 -c catapult_a10 -start ipgenerate -end synthesis.
After synthesis exit 0, run fitter then sta_signoff serially with one Quartus process.
Extract sys_clk_25 setup/hold/recovery/removal/min-pulse, DDR/metastability, MIF consumption and resource metrics; preserve first failure if any.
acceptance: Fresh physical stages on the exact candidate finish with zero errors and nonnegative timing gates, or the first honest Quartus/resource/provenance blocker is recorded. No assembler, SOF, JTAG programming, power or board state change occurs in this task.

resource.policy: Acquire gamepc for every remote write/heavy stage; never stop unknown EDA/JTAG processes; retain fresh probe on failure.

forbidden_regions: RTL/QEMU/QSF/SDC semantic changes during physical run
quartus_pgm, JTAG programming, power cycle, Flash/EPCQ write or board reset
license content and unknown user files

dispatch_history.note: Registration intent only; GamePC was reported offline.

dispatch.note: User reported GamePC started; owner must still perform a read-only online/preflight check and acquire the gamepc lock before any remote write or Quartus stage.
